2026-05-01.title: The Importance of Self-Awareness
2026-05-01.verse: Judah recognized them and said, “She is more upright than I am, because I wouldn’t give her to Shelah my son.” He was not physically intimate with her again.
2026-05-01.observation: This chapter covers something that was very important for the time. It was called the levirate law. Because there was no social safety net to protect and care for the most vulnerable people in the community, the levirate law was established. This law meant that someone would step in and care for a widow by providing them with a child. This gave the woman status within the extended family unit and provided a possible future with a continued family of her own. There were many benefits to this law, and it was designed to care for widows who would become destitute without help. Judah should have done this, but chose to care more about himself and what he considered important rather than Tamar. When Judah realized what had happened, he had enough self-awareness to acknowledge his sin and not condemn Tamar. In life, we will not always get it right. The only thing worse is to continue to defend a sinful position because we are unwilling to measure ourselves the same way we measure others. When we realize we are not perfect, we open the door to see from the point of view of others and increase our compassion.
2026-05-01.application: How can you increase your self-awareness today?
2026-05-01.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for growing us in many different ways.

2026-05-02.title: The Lord Is With You In Dark Places
2026-05-02.verse: The warden did not concern himself with anything that was in Joseph’s care because the Lord was with him and whatever he was doing the Lord was making successful.
2026-05-02.observation: Joseph had received a previous promise from God. It would seem as though his life went from bad to worse ever since. However, when we read the story of Joseph, there are little hints that God is guiding his life. He goes to a slave owner’s house and slowly becomes the administrator of the home. He is placed in prison and slowly becomes the administrator of the prisoners. Joseph doesn’t know it yet, but all of this is preparing him to administrate the entire nation. We do not always understand why God allows the dark seasons of life, but we can confidently understand that He does not waste them. Is it possible that the dark season you are in is preparing you for the next opportunity just around the corner?
2026-05-02.application: How would it change your perspective to realize the Lord is with you in every dark season of life?
2026-05-02.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every dark place.

2026-05-03.title: God Is Moving Behind The Scenes
2026-05-03.verse: After these things happened, the cupbearer to the king of Egypt and the royal baker offended their master, the king of Egypt. Pharaoh was enraged with his two officials, the cupbearer and the baker, so he imprisoned them in the house of the captain of the guard in the same facility where Joseph was confined. The captain of the guard appointed Joseph to be their attendant, and he served them. They spent some time in custody.
2026-05-03.observation: Some people have things come together and thank God. Then, when they realize just how much God moved, they become speechless. They realize that, while they were in the middle of their difficulty and complaining to God about all their hardships, God was moving and setting things into place that they did not notice at the time. Joseph does not realize it, but God was going to use events in Pharaoh's life to rescue him. It may have seemed like only a passing concern to Joseph at the moment. What does Pharaoh’s issue with a cupbearer have to do with his imprisonment? Many times we do not see how God connects the dots. It is only afterward that we realize God has been moving the entire time.
2026-05-03.application: Don’t try to connect the dots yourself. Just realize God is doing work you do not see now, but it will change everything later.
2026-05-03.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being on the move in our lives.

2026-05-04.title: Wisdom Learned In Secret Will Show in Public
2026-05-04.verse: So Pharaoh asked his officials, “Can we find a man like Joseph, one in whom the Spirit of God is present?
2026-05-04.observation: In this chapter, Joseph is not only used by God to interpret the dream, he also stands out as having the wisdom to know how to save the nation. He has the skill to organize the relief effort and to plan out the long-term process of preparation. They were amazed at what he knew, but it does not appear they asked where he had learned it. They said the Lord had given it to him, but did they ever ask Joseph the vehicle or experiences God had led him through to learn it all? If they had, I wonder what they would have said when they learned that Joseph was taught by God through hidden suffering? Joseph learned preparation, administration, and patience by being a slave and being a prisoner. The skills we use are often taught to us in the storms of life. Therefore, do not despise seasons of “hiddenness.” God is teaching you how to thrive in other seasons.
2026-05-04.application: What are you learning in the current season you are in?
2026-05-04.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for never wasting a season. You use all things for the good of those who love You.

2026-05-05.title: When There Are No Good Choices
2026-05-05.verse: But Jacob replied, “My son will not go down there with you, for his brother is dead and he alone is left. If an accident happens to him on the journey you have to make, then you will bring down my gray hair in sorrow to the grave.
2026-05-05.observation: In today’s passage, Jacob has no good options. He cannot let his family starve, but he also feels he cannot let his youngest son go. What do you do when there are no good options? What do you do when it seems there is no way out? The only thing you can do is trust the Lord and make the next right decision. Jacob cannot see it now, so his son Reuben tries to talk with him. We must be willing to listen to those who love us and have our best interest at heart. Many times, all we can do is the best we can. The great secret is the Lord sees us and is already working in ways we do not yet realize. We think we are at the end of the story, but we are not even close. Soon, Jacob will be traveling to see a son he thought was dead. His willingness to make the next right choice, even though it was hard, will lead to an amazing miracle.
2026-05-05.application: What is the next right decision in your life?
2026-05-05.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us when we do not realize it.

2026-05-06.title: God Will Lead You Out of Comfort Zones
2026-05-06.verse: Now the famine was severe in the land. When they finished eating the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Return, buy us a little more food.
2026-05-06.observation: We serve a God of miracles. A miracle is when God interrupts the natural order of the world He has made. Many times, He will do this to show Himself to us. In today’s passage, God could have performed a miracle so that the sons of Jacob did not need to go again to Egypt. However, God allowed natural law to continue in such a way that they were forced out of their comfort zone and confronted with a hard choice. They don’t know it yet, but this hard choice is going to lead them to healing their family wounds and it will ultimately save their family from the continually worsening famine. God could have worked a miracle, but He allowed natural order to continue for His purposes. The same is true today. We often pray and ask God to work miracles. When He does not do things the way we want, we may wonder why. Since God can do it, we should start wondering why He chose not to do it our way. Perhaps He is doing something else and leading us in ways we do not yet see. Maybe He is working to heal a wound we do not even realize we have.
2026-05-06.application: Where do you need to trust God’s leading today?
2026-05-06.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us out of our comfort zones and into all You have for us.

2026-05-07.title: God is Working On Your Enemies, Too
2026-05-07.verse: Judah replied, “What can we say to my lord? What can we speak? How can we clear ourselves? God has exposed the sin of your servants! We are now my lord’s slaves, we and the one in whose possession the cup was found.
2026-05-07.observation: In this passage, we see that the brothers have finally learned the lesson they did not understand long ago. When Joseph was young, they despised their younger brother and were willing to sell him into slavery. Now, many years later, they are willing to take Benjamin’s place as slaves rather than see him become one. Many times, God will work in our lives and we will go through difficult seasons due to the actions of others. While that is happening, we can feel as though our enemies are locked in a pattern. We do not see them changing and going through their own struggles. This can cause us to wonder why God is sparing them from the same pain we endure. However, God is not silent or deaf to the situations in our lives. Just like the Lord was working in Joseph and his brothers’ lives, God works on us and our enemies at the same time. Therefore, do not worry about what God is doing in them. Trust He is leading and molding them, just like He is you.
2026-05-07.application: Who do you need to let go and trust God with today?
2026-05-07.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always doing more than we can see.

2026-05-08.title: Goodness Brings Favor
2026-05-08.verse: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and go to the land of Canaan! Get your father and your households and come to me! Then I will give you the best land in Egypt and you will eat the best of the land.’
2026-05-08.observation: One of the aspects of the story of Joseph is the kindness shown to him by the pharaoh. This is a stark contrast to what we will find in the book of Exodus. This pharaoh likely had great respect for Joseph because he was used by God to organize a relief effort before they even knew they needed it. According to the text, it appears as though Joseph showed integrity in all his preparations and continued to do his job, even after being vindicated. Therefore, when it was time for Joseph to need something, pharaoh went overboard in being gracious. We should never be good in order to manipulate people. However, being good has its rewards. When we show goodness to others, the Lord has a way of returning it to us in ways we do not always expect.
2026-05-08.application: Who is someone that has shown you kindness that now needs your help today?
2026-05-08.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being the ultimate Good in our lives.

2026-05-09.title: God Walks With Us To The End
2026-05-09.verse: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there. I will go down with you to Egypt and I myself will certainly bring you back from there. Joseph will close your eyes.
2026-05-09.observation: While the Bible does not say this specifically, it’s possible to wonder if Jacob thought he could have been leaving God behind. During this time in history, many people believed there were gods everywhere and they all occupied certain geographical regions. This is another reason why it was such a big deal for Abraham to leave everything and go to an unknown land. In his mind, it could have been truly stepping out into a vulnerable place. It is possible that God is reminding Jacob that He is not bound by a certain place. He will not leave Jacob as he goes into a new area. God will go with Jacob and be with him even to the point of death. This is a great reminder for us. God is not bound by space and time. There is nowhere we can go that He does not go with us. He is there. He will continue to walk with us. He goes with us through it all, all the way to the end and beyond.
2026-05-09.application: How would your day change if you realized there is nowhere you will go that God will not go, too?
2026-05-09.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for walking with us through every season and situation of life.

2026-05-10.title: Prospering in Problem Times
2026-05-10.verse: Israel settled in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen, and they owned land there. They were fruitful and increased rapidly in number.
2026-05-10.observation: While the nation of Egypt was suffering and slowly losing everything into the hands of Pharaoh, the Lord was blessing the nation of Israel as they settled into their new home. This is not the home they wanted, but they were making the best of it. When they decided to go “all in” and trust the Lord was leading them, it turned out better than they probably hoped it would. When we decide we will embrace the change God has brought us to, we can find a new momentum we didn’t expect. This does not always mean we will prosper on the outside. There will be difficult seasons that God will allow into our lives for different reasons. However, He always goes with us and our soul prospers as we know He will take care of us through it all.
2026-05-10.application: How can your soul prosper during the current season you are experiencing?
2026-05-10.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for taking difficult seasons and turning them into fertilizer for future growth.

2026-05-11.title: The Lord is With Us, Not Just Our Heroes
2026-05-11.verse: Then Israel said to Joseph, “I am about to die, but God will be with you and will bring you back to the land of your fathers.
2026-05-11.observation: Many times, we hear of the amazing feats of our heroes in the faith and almost think they have a different relationship with God than we do. God is the same, but it seems like they have attained a place in Him that simply is not possible for us. This is, of course, not true. Jacob is reminding Joseph that God will be with Joseph the same way He has been with him. It’s important that we realize God does not have any favorites in His kingdom. He loves us all. What God does in someone’s life has nothing to do with how He feels about us. If nothing else, it is a blessing. We can look at what God has done through someone else and realize that same God loves us, too.
2026-05-11.application: Never look at someone else to determine if God loves you. He does love you and it is more than you can imagine.
2026-05-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us all with an everlasting love.

2026-05-12.title: God Gives Us What We Need
2026-05-12.verse: These are the twelve tribes of Israel. This is what their father said to them when he blessed them. He gave each of them an appropriate blessing.
2026-05-12.observation: If you have had brothers or sisters, you possibly have the same thought I had when reading this chapter. I wonder if any of these brothers were listening to what their father said and gauged it by what he said about them. There is something about us humans that we are constantly comparing ourselves to each other. There is a great moment in a book I read once about a magic mirror that would show you your deepest heart’s desire. The author of the book said that the “well-ordered mind” would look back at the mirror and see only a reflection of themselves. In other words, they had made peace with themselves and did not need to be anyone else. I would say this is also the attribute of the mature Christian. We realize that God does not consult our neighbor to determine His plan for our lives. He blesses us according to what He has in store for us. Therefore, we can rejoice with our neighbor because God loves us both and each of us stands on our own before the Lord with joy.
2026-05-12.application: Take joy in knowing God loves you without regard for your neighbor, their successes, and failures.
2026-05-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us the way You do.

2026-05-13.title: All Things Work Together for Good
2026-05-13.verse: But Joseph answered them, “Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God? As for you, you meant to harm me, but God intended it for a good purpose, so he could preserve the lives of many people, as you can see this day. So now, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little children.” Then he consoled them and spoke kindly to them.
2026-05-13.observation: Many of us would not have a problem with Joseph if he were bitter with his brothers. It was their act that sent him to Egypt. However, Joseph has a different point of view. He sees God at work in every one of his difficulties. He realized that God used all the events of his life as vehicles to get him to the place he currently enjoyed. This did not absolve his brothers of justice. He reminded them that God alone was going to do the punishing. However, Joseph was not going to allow what they did to keep him from seeing the good. When we begin to realize that no one can stop God from doing what He wants to do in our lives, we begin to stop seeing people as having the power to stop us. We see everything as part of God’s ultimate plan.
2026-05-13.application: How would it change your day if you realized that all things will be used by God for your good?
2026-05-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being trustworthy. We trust that You never waste anything we go through.

2026-05-14.title: If God Were Real…
2026-05-14.verse: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation,
2026-05-14.observation: One of the objections I have heard over and over is that if God were real, why doesn’t He show Himself? Wouldn’t it make sense for Him to reveal Himself to us rather than being hidden. Either God is not real or deism is true… that is that God spun everything into existence, then backed up and let it play out. Enter Jesus. Jesus came and entered into our reality. He showed Himself to us and said, “I’m the one you have been asking to see. Here I am. I really do exist and I am here.” So, when someone says that if God were real He would show Himself to us, I always start to agree and say they are right. Surely, a good God would show Himself. Then, I start talking about Jesus.
2026-05-14.application: Realize that the Creator of the world has already shown up.
2026-05-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being real and true.

2026-05-16.title: Just Visiting
2026-05-16.verse: Therefore, if you have been raised with Christ, keep seeking the things above, where Christ is, seated at the right hand of God. Keep thinking about things above, not things on the earth,
2026-05-16.observation: My wife loves to play a game called Monopoly. In the game, you are supposed to slowly try to buy property and make money. Sometimes you can draw a card that says you have to “go to jail.” It’s terrible because when you go to jail it costs you in the game. However, you can also get a card that sends you to jail but you’re not in jail, you’re “just visiting.” This is the way God’s Word wants us to think about our life on this Earth. We don’t see it as our final destination. We live here but we are no longer from here. Our ultimate address is now in Heaven with our Heavenly Father. We have a temporary address here, but we are just visiting. Now, we have to have a balanced attitude. We cannot use this as an excuse to not do the right thing while still living here. However, this gives us endless hope. While the world rages, Heaven is unbothered. Our heavenly home waits.
2026-05-16.application: Remember that nothing that will happen today changes the reality of our eternal hope.
2026-05-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for welcoming us into Your family.

2026-05-17.title: Radical Warfare
2026-05-17.verse: So put to death whatever in your nature belongs to the earth: sexual immorality, impurity, shameful passion, evil desire, and greed which is idolatry.
2026-05-17.observation: Paul didn’t mess around when talking about what to do with the sins that lurk within us. We have to remember… salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone. However, that faith will not stay alone. As we begin to follow Jesus, there are still enemies in the land that will threaten our allegiance to Jesus. We must deal with them. God knows that this only happens when we get serious about it. We cannot negotiate with our sin. It only leads to more death. Therefore, we must be radical about our desire to absolutely destroy our sin so we can have freedom. The best news is, God helps us every step of the way.
2026-05-17.application: Go to war with the dark places in your life. Bring it to God’s light. You won’t find shame. You’ll find healing.
2026-05-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for loving us more than we will ever be able to understand.

2026-05-18.title: Actions Required
2026-05-18.verse: And tell Archippus, “See to it that you complete the ministry you received in the Lord.
2026-05-18.observation: I would love to know what prompted Paul to speak to Archippus at the end of his letter. Paul is about to finalize the letter and send it on its way, but stops to speak one more thing. He reminds Archippus to finish what was started in him. It would benefit all of us to remember the words spoken to Archippus. “God has started a great work in you. He has given you a ministry. Be sure you stay faithful to it and carry it out.”
2026-05-18.application: Don’t get weary in serving God. Carry it out.
2026-05-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us what faithfulness looks like.

2026-05-19.title: Fear God Above All Else
2026-05-19.verse: And because the midwives feared God, he made households for them.
2026-05-19.observation: When it comes to the ethics of living in this world, we can sometimes become confused over how we interact with the various seasons of life. We live in two kingdoms at once, the kingdom of God and the kingdoms of this world. Our highest law is the kingdom of God. This almost always makes us great citizens in the kingdoms of this world, because we end up obeying the laws of the land by default. However, there will come times when the laws of the land will not agree with the law of God. When this happens, we always obey the LORD. The midwives disobeyed the law of Pharaoh because the higher law of God prevailed. When we choose to obey God rather than men, the LORD will bless us for it. This is usually not easy, but it is holy.
2026-05-19.application: Make sure you obey God above all else.
2026-05-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us into all righteousness.

2026-05-20.title: The LORD Hears You
2026-05-20.verse: God heard their groaning; God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob. God saw the Israelites, and God understood.
2026-05-20.observation: Israel had been in slavery for hundreds of years. We can sometimes think the Lord doesn’t hear us after a weekend of prayer. Can you imagine how alone and forsaken the nation of Israel must have felt? However, they were never alone. God heard them. God remembered them. God saw them. When the time was right, the Lord moved. We do not always know why God’s timetable is what it is. We do not always understand why God waits as long as He does. However, we know the Lord is good and His mercy shines forever. Therefore, we can trust that He never allows us to suffer for no reason. Our job is to be faithful and to trust the Lord in all things.
2026-05-20.application: Are you willing to wait for the Lord?
2026-05-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for seeing us in every struggle.

2026-05-21.title: God Is With Us Even Before The Danger Comes
2026-05-21.verse: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go, not even under force. So I will extend my hand and strike Egypt with all my wonders that I will do among them, and after that he will release you.
2026-05-21.observation: This is one of the most powerful chapters in the Old Testament. The LORD reveals Himself to Moses and sends Moses on a mission of freedom. One of the most amazing aspects of this story is that God tells Moses in advance that the journey will be difficult. We can sometimes assume that because the Lord is sending us, it will be easy. Surely the Lord will not send us into danger! Not so. Many times, our journey with the Lord will send us straight through difficulty. However, the Lord goes with us and wins the battle before we even arrive. The Lord told Moses that it would be hard, but the Lord will prevail in the end. The same is true for us. Our lives will often be more difficult than we expected, but the Lord always prevails in the end. Our job is to stay faithful, stay close to Him, and take the next step.
2026-05-21.application: The journey will be hard. Your job is not to figure out the end. Your job is the next step.
2026-05-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for knowing the end from the beginning.

2026-05-22.title: God Has Answers
2026-05-22.verse: Moses answered again, “And if they do not believe me or pay attention to me, but say, ‘The Lord has not appeared to you’?” The Lord said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A staff.
2026-05-22.observation: Moses had so many questions. It is impossible to tell if he had innocent questions or if he thought he could somehow convince God that there were too many reasons to choose someone else. However, for every question, the LORD had an answer. Just like Moses, we will often have many questions about our life, our calling, our future, and more. If we are willing to seek the LORD, He will provide the answers we need. This does not mean He will give us the answers we want. Moses asked what to do if the people did not believe him. God responded, but not in a way Moses may have expected. The same goes for us. We must be careful not to preload our expected answers. Ask God, then study His Word. Let the truth of God’s Word lead us wherever it will.
2026-05-22.application: Don’t just let questions linger. Take them to God by studying His Word and watch what He does.
2026-05-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being willing to give answers to all our endless questions.

2026-05-23.title: Worse Before It Gets Better
2026-05-23.verse: That same day Pharaoh commanded the slave masters and foremen who were over the people: “You must no longer give straw to the people for making bricks as before. Let them go and collect straw for themselves. But you must require of them the same quota of bricks that they were making before. Do not reduce it, for they are slackers. That is why they are crying, ‘Let us go sacrifice to our God.’ Make the work harder for the men so they will keep at it and pay no attention to lying words!
2026-05-23.observation: I have heard of people before who swallowed something poisonous. They go to the emergency room and the doctors will give them medicine intended to cause their body to expel anything in their digestive tract. The goal is to make them better, but it will get worse before it gets better. There are many examples of this in life, and we see this happening in today’s text. God has appointed that it is time for the nation of Israel to be free. However, this does not mean things will immediately get better. Sometimes, breaking free means it will get worse first. If we do not remember that the LORD is in control, we can become discouraged. However, when we realize that the LORD has promised to work all things for our good, we will not see things getting worse as anything other than the LORD doing what has to be done. Do not let outward, temporary circumstances shake your faith that the LORD is still in control.
2026-05-23.application: Determine to not let any outside circumstances shake your faith in God’s ultimate plan of victory.
2026-05-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being in control when the world looks out of control.

2026-05-24.title: The Battle of Perspective
2026-05-24.verse: When the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt, he said to him, “I am the Lord. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I am telling you.” But Moses said before the Lord, “Since I speak with difficulty, why should Pharaoh listen to me?
2026-05-24.observation: It would seem that one of the greatest obstacles in the story of Israel’s freedom was Moses getting past his insecurities. He continued to see this battle as a conflict between Pharaoh and himself. In this conflict, it appears as though he assumed he was fighting against Pharaoh all alone. The better perspective was to realize that God was there the whole time. He is never going before Pharaoh alone. Even if Pharaoh said no, that is his problem. Moses is merely the messenger. How many times do we lose perspective in our own lives because we think we have to figure everything out on our own, do everything on our own, and walk through life alone? What would happen if we realized that God is with us in every step, in every conversation, and in control in more ways than we realize? Would it change how we faced every obstacle today?
2026-05-24.application: Think of God as walking beside you today. Does it change the way you engage with your world?
2026-05-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every moment.

2026-05-25.title: God Has Enemies But No Rivals
2026-05-25.verse: When the fish that were in the Nile died, the Nile began to stink, so that the Egyptians could not drink water from the Nile. There was blood everywhere in the land of Egypt! But the magicians of Egypt did the same by their secret arts, and so Pharaoh’s heart remained hard, and he refused to listen to Moses and Aaron—just as the Lord had predicted. And Pharaoh turned and went into his house. He did not pay any attention to this.
2026-05-25.observation: The magicians thought they were showing their worth by proving they could add to what God was doing. However, an assertion of dominance would have been to overpower the will of God and to remove the plague. This shows that they were not really a threat to God. They could only mimic His greatness. God has many enemies and there will be many foes in our lives that will try to take the place of God in our lives. However, none of them are greater than the Lord and none of them pose any threat to His rule. Therefore, we should never live in fear of the enemies of God. They may be able to do harm, but they can never overpower the Lord. He has no rivals to His Throne. He is King forever.
2026-05-25.application: Live your day with a holy confidence that your Heavenly Father is on the Throne. This does not make us better than anyone else. It makes us servants of Him who is greater than all things.
2026-05-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for reigning supreme forever.

2026-05-26.title: What Have You Done For Me Lately?
2026-05-26.verse: So Moses went out from Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord, and the Lord did as Moses asked—he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. Not one remained! But Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also and did not release the people.
2026-05-26.observation: When my girls were little, it was sometimes frustrating as a dad how quickly they would forget things. We would take a day and have so much fun. We would go to the park, go out to eat, and play games late into the night. However, if we did not do the same thing the next day, they would say they never get to do anything fun. It would be frustrating that their appreciation seemed to reset every evening. Then, one day I noticed myself doing the exact same thing to the Lord. I would experience the greatness of God one day and wake up the next day wondering why God only blessed others. We can see the same thing happening to Pharaoh in this passage. When God’s greatness was being displayed in front of him, Pharaoh recognized who God was. However, as soon as the moment had passed, he questioned God’s greatness. May it never be said of us. May we always remember God’s greatness and realize God does not have to prove Himself to us over and over again.
2026-05-26.application: Do you sometimes forget God’s goodness from day to day? List five things God has done within the past week that you need to be sure not to forget.
2026-05-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being patient with us.

2026-05-27.title: Learning From the Stubbornness of Others
2026-05-27.verse: Those of Pharaoh’s servants who feared the Lord’s message hurried to bring their servants and livestock into the houses, but those who did not take the Lord’s message seriously left their servants and their cattle in the field.
2026-05-27.observation: I heard someone once say, “Everyone has value, even if it is to be a bad example.” This is true. There are some things we can only learn by experiencing them for ourselves. However, there are many things we can learn by watching the successes and faithfulness of others. In today’s passage, the officials of Pharaoh had learned from the past and the difficulty they and others around them had experienced. Therefore, they listened to the Word of God and took precautions. Hopefully, those who watched the mercy they received learned from their example and followed their lead the next time. What can you learn from others today? What can others learn from you? How can you be an example of grace to someone today?
2026-05-27.application: Think about the influences in your life right now. What can you learn about God through their influence?
2026-05-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for constantly leading us into more and more freedom.

2026-05-28.title: Trying to Compromise With God
2026-05-28.verse: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, “Go, serve the Lord—only your flocks and herds will be detained. Even your families may go with you.” But Moses said, “Will you also provide us with sacrifices and burnt offerings that we may present them to the Lord our God?
2026-05-28.observation: I heard someone once define compromise as halfway happy. I have also heard people talk about their relationship with God as something that sounds like a business deal where they are trying to find a compromise. They want to honor God, but they also want God to honor some things they want, too. That is not how it works. Imagine you were in the ocean drowning and a stranger came to save you. Would you try to negotiate how they threw you a life preserver, what they came there in, and how they went about saving you? No. I imagine you would tell them you were willing to do anything for salvation. Since they were a stranger, all you could do is hope they would be good. Now, imagine it was your best friend. You would simply let them do what needed to be done, because you completely trusted they were out for your best interest. That is the way we should see our salvation. There is no need for compromise. We simply trust. The One who loves us the most is the one who is reaching out to save us.
2026-05-28.application: Are you trying to hold on to something and hoping God will compromise His Word to make you happy? Is it time to let go and trust Him?
2026-05-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being trustworthy.

2026-05-29.title: The LORD Shows Us the Ditch
2026-05-29.verse: Moses said, “This is what the Lord has said: ‘About midnight I will go throughout Egypt, and all the firstborn in the land of Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, to the firstborn son of the slave girl who is at her hand mill, and all the firstborn of the cattle.
2026-05-29.observation: I was once riding with some friends and the driver kept swerving closer and closer to the ditch. While we were all laughing at her inability to pay attention, we were also becoming increasingly concerned. Finally, the friend in the passenger seat prayed, “Lord, show her the ditch!” Once again, we were all having a good time, but the reality of the danger was real. The passenger was praying the Lord would make her aware of the danger so she would take proper precautions to stay away from it. God continues to show Pharaoh the danger of not obeying, but Pharaoh refuses to pay attention to the consequences of his actions. The consequences become worse and worse, yet Pharaoh continues to move forward blindly. How many times do we need to do this? How different could things have been if Pharaoh had finally realized he was headed for disaster before it was too late?
2026-05-29.application: Pray and ask the Lord to show you any possible “ditches” in your life before you fall into them. If He does, have the courage to make necessary course corrections.
2026-05-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us what’s wrong in our lives so we can be free.

2026-05-31.title: The LORD is a Promise Keeper
2026-05-31.verse: It was a night of vigil for the Lord to bring them out from the land of Egypt, and so on this night all Israel is to keep the vigil to the Lord for generations to come.
2026-05-31.observation: If someone promises something, we tend to judge the faithfulness of their promise by how quickly they come through. For example, if someone says they will buy you lunch, the assumption is it will be that same day. If they do not buy lunch that day, it is common to assume they were not faithful to keep their word. However, the promise did not have a due date. Therefore, the promise is still good. It is only the timing that is possibly flexible. This is the same with God. When God promises to do something, we tend to judge His faithfulness based on how quickly He does it. However, this is not how it works. God is always doing more than we realize. For example, imagine the person we mentioned above did not buy lunch that day because your favorite restaurant was closed. The next day they bought lunch and did so from your favorite restaurant. Not only would they be considered faithful, they would be considered thoughtful, too. That’s the same with the LORD. He does above and beyond all we think.
2026-05-31.application: Where do you need to trust God’s faithfulness over your idea of timing today?
2026-05-31.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being better than we realize.
